newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex re-entry Viscofan starts on firm foot.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex re-entry Viscofan starts on firm foot.

text.p: Sausage skin-maker Viscofan, which re-entered Spain's Ibex-35 index on Tuesday, got off to a sizzling start within the blue chip index by outpacing the Ibex itself, dealers said.
At 1330 GMT, Viscofan was up 70 pesetas, 2.03 percent, to 3,515 while the Ibex-35 blue chip index was up 0.55 percent to 6,922.19.
Other new components steel tubing firm Tubacex, up 3 pesetas to 509, and Asturiana, up 10 pesetas to 3,130, were trading below the market however.

Acciona, a building firm excluded from the Ibex in the reshuffle, was also outperforming, recouping ground lost after the news of its exclusion from the index of 35 key stocks, dealers said. Acciona was up 2.53 percent to 17,020 pesetas.

"Aside from all the speculative movements on the announcement (of Ibex inclusions and exclusions) we're still seeing quite a lot of interest in Acciona, with people taking advantange of yesterday's fall to buy in again," said a dealer at a foreign broker.
He said Viscofan and zinc producer Asturiana should be boosted by the dollar's rise.
"Viscofan and Asturiana, particularly Viscofan, are helped by the strong dollar. Practically all Viscofan's sales are in dollars. This could be one of the reasons behind today's rise."
All three newcomers had had a good run up to today's incorporation, dealers said, and may have further to go.
"On a fundamental basis, analysts say that all three are overvalued, but of course, that's not the same as what a trader will tell you," a Spanish dealer said.
However he added he would sell Viscofan at these levels because of technical factors.
